sources.title: 1969 Tri-Muff V1 by Stomp Under Foot | RockBoard | PedalPedia
sources.excerpt: 1969 Tri-Muff V1 by Stomp Under Foot | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Stomp Under Foot 1969 Tri-Muff V1 LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS FUZZ Description The 1969 Triangles are the very first versions of the Big Muff. Originally they were built on perf board and there are several different versions in this series. I have gone through all of the different versions I have had the opportunity to trace out and this one is my favorite. These early pedals are a bit more scooped than later ones and they are made with part values that were never used again. The overall tone of the pedal is pretty balanced with just a little extra low end throughout and the fuzz has a huge, gnarly sound with a loose break-up in the fuzz on the lower strings.
